Players Committee errata-sheet slip of [[I Think I Can Handle Myself (Errata)]] (PC-E1), game text: “If your female character is defending a battle alone at a site, add one destiny to total power (if Rey, she is also immune to attrition). OR Cancel a weapon destiny targeting your female character. OR Add 1 to your Force drain where you have a female character.”

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/errata_2019.pdf Errata Sheet 2019] (Players Committee), page 2, PDF built 21 March 2019. The slip was cut from the page rendered at 300 dpi (the PDF draws its text over a background image), at the slip's outline.

Edits: none.
